title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode4 Composing Camp!

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: A few days later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Come on in♪
Hehe. I'm so happy about you staying over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm a little excited since I've never done a songwriting camp before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! It's too bad that Shiho and Hona can't come...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we just gotta do our best to knock their socks off by writing an amazing song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that!
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, let's begin our inaugural songwriting camp♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You're making it sound so extravagant. It's just the two of us, remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, we gotta hype ourselves up.
Anyway, let's start listening to the chord progressions we each came up with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, Ichi!
I sent my ideas over to your phone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll send you mine now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so cool!
I can't wait to hear what you came up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I spent a lot of time coming up with mine, so hurry! You gotta listen to them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright. Then, why don't we start by listening to each other's stuff?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa... Ichi, this is so good!
They're so straightforward and powerful...
I bet we can turn this into a really amazing song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-You think so?
But I'm glad you're saying that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My hope for this song is that it'll help remind everyone about those who matter most to them and reinforce those bonds.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I like it since it's got you written all over it, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...! I liked yours a lot too, Saki. It's really cheerful, but a little sad at times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. So, mine's about being able to move forward regardless of any doubt or pain you might be feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Which is a nice reflection of your personality.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now I really want to come up with a melody for this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! So, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
But being in the same room like this might make things a bit awkward...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, can I use the living room?
I feel like we're going to distract each other if we're sitting right next to each other like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
That's too bad since you went to the trouble of coming over, but I guess we don't have a choice...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, let's meet back up once we've both finished our songs!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
See you!
And let's do our best, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright...!
I've gotta do my best to come up with a really great melody!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Hehe. This chord progression sounds so much like something Ichi would come up with...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (A song to remind people about who matters most to them, and those bonds, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Based on my own feelings and this chord progression...)
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think it's turning out pretty well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's a little rough around the edges, but the basic idea's there. I can show it to Ichi once I brush it up just a...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Who could that be? Did we get a delivery?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Coming!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Shiho?! Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We wanted to do something for you both since you're working so hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, Shiho and I decided to bring over some gifts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It isn't much, but I stopped by the convenience store and grabbed some snacks for you two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, take a look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, potato chips and chocolate cookies... Wait, there's more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi!
These say they're yakisoba bun flavored!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Look at that...
I didn't know they made these kinds of snacks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I just happened to come across them.
Let us know how they taste.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I made some seafood curry. I was sort of wondering if you had a chance to eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
We totally forgot about dinner!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. We were so focused on songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sort of seems normal when it comes to writing songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In any case, I'm glad we brought these over.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't you both stay and eat?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Since we're all here, we should have dinner together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. If you both have time, would you be willing to stay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, wanna stay for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mmm... This curry's really good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're such an amazing cook, Hona!
Also, I love how this is loaded with veggies! It's so filling!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Saki, the curry your family makes always had a lot of vegetables in it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It tastes like we made it♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Except not since the Mochizukis did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually made this curry with the one your family makes in mind, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I know that you like your curry bold, Ichika, so I decided to put in some grated apples.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
That's really thoughtful of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks so much!
I feel energized already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, stop.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it's true. This is just what we needed. I feel like we'll be able to come up with a really good song now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Shiho, we'll have the snacks you brought while we do.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, good luck.
